text:
alex: CI on main is red, looks like a batch of golden snapshot failures in prompt-serializer tests. failing job: https://ci.redwood.example/org/123/job/456
ci-bot: build #789 failed — 12 tests failed, rerun queued: https://ci.redwood.example/org/123/job/456/console
maria: which tests are failing specifically?
alex: failing tests: `test_system_prompt_normalization`, `test_prompt_whitespace`, `test_serialization_roundtrip::test_multiline_prompts`
ryan: any diff examples from the snapshot output?
alex: small example from the CI artifact (trimmed):

```
- expected: "<system>Hello there</system>"
+ actual:   "<system>Hello there </system>"
```

Trailing space introduced in serialized system token. looks like spacing/serializer change, not model output.
samir: that smells like the tokenizer/serializer change we landed in d3f4a2c last week. could be non-deterministic ordering too.
maria: can you reproduce locally? if so try `./tools/run_golden_tests --filter system_prompt_normalization --update=false` and attach the diff.
alex: repros locally for me. command I used:

```
GOLDEN_DIR=./tests/goldens ./tools/run_golden_tests --filter "system_prompt" --jobs 1
```

Diff matches CI. I don't want to `--update` unless we're sure.
ryan: if it's from that commit we can bisect. steps:

```
# on a clean main
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git bisect start HEAD d3f4a2c~1
git bisect run ./tools/run_golden_tests --filter system_prompt_normalization --no-color || true
```

If bisect is noisy, run single test binary with the `--seed` flag.
samir: I can run the bisect on a beefy instance (local laptop is flaky). give me 30m.
ci-bot: rerun triggered by @alex — job #790 pending.
maria: one quick check: confirm `pip freeze` shows the same `tokenizers`/`sentencepiece` versions as CI image. serialization bugs often from minor version drift.
alex: CI image: `python:3.10-slim + tokenizers==0.13.3`; local was 0.14.0 — good catch, will match and retry.
samir: quick update after bisect: bisect pointed at commit `d3f4a2c` — the serializer trimming change. creating PR to revert the whitespace trimming for system prompts and add a unit test.
ryan: thanks — if PR fixes, add a test that covers both trimmed and untrimmed cases and run `--jobs 4` to surface timing/order flakes.
alex: great. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1123 — added test and a changelog note. cc @maria @samir
maria: reviewed, left minor nits. once CI passes we can merge and re-run a full golden job to confirm.
alex: merging after CI green. thanks all :thumbsup:
